comment: Source review 5a: parseoptions() matches the abbreviation menu_first_pa to the menu_first_page row, but shared_menu_optfn() (options.c 2054-2062) refuses it because check_misc_menu_command() (695-707) wants the complete name and returns -1, so the statement fails silently; the full menu_last_page:} beside it is applied.
